question_text: One inch numerical and categorical types of data.
answer_text: Numerical data (données numériques) refers to data that can be measured and expressed as numbers, such as height or weight, and can be further divided into discrete (discrètes) and continuous (continues) types. Categorical data (données catégoriques), on the other hand, refers to data that can be grouped into categories or labels, such as colors or genres, and can be further divided into nominal (nominales) and ordinal (ordinales) types.
